5439fe65-5b3a-420e-9ef4-27c9bcc49c5a.description: In a town with nothing, in the middle of a daily life with seemingly no signs of change, high schooler Reiji Kurose was "just" living. Family, dreams for the future, childhood friends were all binding him down to that city. He thought he would "just" keep on living like that. Until he met her. Is there hope in living? Is there light waiting ahead?

d46d9573-2ad9-45b2-9b6d-45f95452d1c0.title: Gongjakbuin'eui 50-gaji Tea Recipe
d46d9573-2ad9-45b2-9b6d-45f95452d1c0.description:
Saat aku membuka mataku, aku menjadi seorang Duchess.

Namun ada yang tidak beres. Aku sudah menjadi karakter ini tetapi hanya namaku saja yang bergelar ‘Duchess’. Nyatanya aku diperlakukan buruk oleh pelayan dan diabaikan oleh suaminya. Kehidupan yang sangat malang! Astaga, aku tidak tahu harus berbuat apa lagi. Aku hanya akan bersikap tenang sembari menikmati tehku, itulah yang aku pikirkan.

"Bisakah kamu menyeduhkan teh untukku lain kali?”

Ada yang salah dengan suamiku yang dingin!

46b5534d-ef35-46ed-b169-c83a4f207c7e.title: This Girl Is a Little Wild
46b5534d-ef35-46ed-b169-c83a4f207c7e.description:
As he was being defeated, the Demon King used the last of his strength to curse Sir Roel, the legendary captain of the Holy Knights, into the body of a weak girl. Roel — who was a woman to begin with! — tired of her former life and unable to return to her original body, decides to live a luxurious life as Sila Epheria, the noble daughter whose soul got swapped with hers. Things don't go according to plan when her new family puts her in danger, forcing her to find a way to prove her true identity…   
  
Will Roel/Sila be able to live a quiet life as she wishes? Or is there something more to the new life she's received?

c5ea2d8c-db81-4556-b34f-631839115ce8.title: The Flower Dances and the Wind Sings
c5ea2d8c-db81-4556-b34f-631839115ce8.altTitle: The Flower Dance and the Wind Song
c5ea2d8c-db81-4556-b34f-631839115ce8.description:
As Ersella lies on her deathbed, she has only one regret: never being a good mother to her son, Vicente. When fate sends her back three years, she gets a chance to make things right. While reflecting on her past as a young bride and reluctant mother, Ersella begins to untangle years’ worth of heartache. But as familial, marital, and even political issues enter the picture, she realizes there’s more to her second life than she thought. Will Ersella’s change of heart be too little, too late? 

---
Ercella lived a glorious life everyone envied, but died of an illness at a young age. Before her death, she regretted not having become a proper mother to her son. But somehow, she went back three years ago. Ercella is living her second life. She promises to be a loving mother this time. However, is it too late?

“Now that you’re doing this, you’re just making me feel uncomfortable.”

The son only pushes her away and she realises that her relationship with the husband, who she thought was fine before her regression, wasn't actually…

---
**Content warning:** Deals with topics of child neglect, postpartum depression, and suicidal ideation.

773e5993-821a-4cea-8b44-f4450112a8f5.title: Watashi wa Akuyaku Reijou nanka ja Nai!!: Yami Tsukai dakara tte Kanarazushimo Akuyaku da to Omou na yo
773e5993-821a-4cea-8b44-f4450112a8f5.altTitle: I'm not a villainess!! Just Because I Can Control Darkness, Doesn't Mean I'm a villain
773e5993-821a-4cea-8b44-f4450112a8f5.description:
Due to a certain incident, Sakura's life ended abruptly. To think her life amounted to this…

Though depressed for a brief moment, she soon realized she'd reincarnated into the world of a novel she once read! Even so, the person she reincarnated as was none other than the villainess, Claudia.

Under the divine protection of the Dark Spirit King, she finds herself despised by those around her, and, in the end, she's fated to meet a tragic death?! No way in hell she'll let both her last life *and* this one meet a Bad End! But even when she tries to take action to somehow change her fate…?

The long awaited manga adaptation of a unique villainess' fantasy tale!

3f5bc21d-6575-4fe0-b03f-50c8bb88dc6b.title: Geuksosu
3f5bc21d-6575-4fe0-b03f-50c8bb88dc6b.description:
A story of murder and violence, **"Unhinged"** follows Erika as she walks a path of vengeance. Seven years ago, Erika came home to find her husband murdered. Unable to find any other suspects, Erika was found guilty and spends most of a decade plotting her revenge from the inside of a cell.
Once freed, she finds herself moving past the boundaries of *"respectable"* society and beyond the shackles of morality. Laws will be broken, lives will be lost, and, yes, there will be blood.


---

**Note:** The series was cancelled by Lezhin after Season 1 (72 chapters+ Prologue). It has since resumed serialization on Comico.

607759cc-aa6a-4470-8f7c-9bbf8253b915.title: Taika no Risei
607759cc-aa6a-4470-8f7c-9bbf8253b915.description: As birth rates decline, in an effort to increase the total population of Japan, the country has implemented... a pet-humanism policy...? As more and more owners "humanize" their pets--having them become members of society--Japan begins to experience a hike in economic growth, as well as in increase in crimes committed by these "dogmen" and "catmen"... In the midst of such social unrest, what could possibly be of bigger concern to one cynical high school girl named Ao...?

943cad8a-3975-4dee-a0f9-d752277f6573.altTitle: A Cunningly Cute Girl Whose Entire Life Plan Gets Completely Wrecked Because of a Soft, Gentle Guy at Her Workplace.
943cad8a-3975-4dee-a0f9-d752277f6573.description: Born and raised in the absolute sticks, big-city office worker Hayamiya Suzuri’s goal was a glamorous marriage to an elite, handsome man! At least, that’s how it was supposed to be… but now, she can’t take her eyes off her plain and unremarkable coworker, Haruno Kounosuke—a man who is the polar opposite of her ideal?! Even though she wants to remain a "calculating" and wonderful city girl, her heart won't stop throbbing at Haruno’s every little move. Constantly jerked around by the somewhat mysterious and elusive Haruno, an unexpected office rom-com begins!

But after being coerced into joining the school's biking team, the Hummingbird Crew, he discovers a whole new world outside of studying.
